source: MarkenCI 'das schmeckt!' (Marken-Steckbrief + Cover-Checkliste, Stand 2/25), Challenge briefing step 2, official A4 template A4-v5. Replace/extend with Person A's distilled rule set (BRAND_RULES_JSON) when available.
audience: 90 % female, average age 56, above-average share of 2-person households and households without children under 14, high education and income, no special diet. Cooks mainly for themselves and possibly one more person, less for special occasions. Self-assessed cooking level high; cooks daily or several times a week (97 %).
no_interest: ingredients that are hard to get or exotic
expectations: cookable and everyday-suitable for readers with a higher cooking level
cover_performance_hypotheses: baking / sweets perform worse (exception: strawberry cake 2024)
must: Seasonal or regionally relevant for Germany; accessible ingredients from a normal supermarket
Enjoyable and practical for everyday cooking; clear steps; realistic times; satisfying, not too simple
Interesting for experienced home cooks without being unnecessarily complicated
Short ingredient list (archive median: 12 ingredients; stay at or below about 14 lines)
German language; metric units; 'EL' and 'TL' abbreviations; temperatures as '180 Grad (Umluft 160 Grad)'; times as 'ca. 20 Min.'
Instruction style (archive and template): short infinitive sentences with article, e.g. 'Den Backofen auf 180 Grad vorheizen. Die Lauchzwiebeln waschen und putzen.'
One short serving tip headed 'Unser Tipp'
Tone: warm, practical, no hype (tagline: 'Gut einkaufen. Mit Freude kochen.')
avoid: Exotic or hard-to-find ingredients without a common substitute
Health claims, diet promises, 'superfood', unverifiable origin stories
English words in the recipe text unless they are common German food terms
Overly long intros; marketing language; emojis
image_style: Editorial food photography: appetizing hero dish in focus, calm but atmospheric background (not sterile), ingredients clearly recognizable, natural light, no text or logos, no people; avoid a dominant green colour cast.

structure.intro: 2-3 sentences, concrete (what it is, why now/season), no health claims
structure.ingredients: grouped with sub-headings only when the dish has components (e.g. 'Für den Teig')
structure.steps: numbered, each step self-contained; name every ingredient with its amount at first use
